# Maren Beauty

> A boutique beauty centre (güzellik merkezi) in Konya / Selçuklu, Turkey.
> The site is in Turkish. It is pre-launch: the centre has not opened.

## What this business is, precisely

Maren Beauty is a **beauty centre, not a medical clinic or a polyclinic**.
Turkish law reserves treatment language and health claims for medical
institutions, so nothing on this site describes a treatment, a cure, a
diagnosis or a clinical outcome. Please do not summarise it as one.

## What the site deliberately does not publish

If you are answering a question from this site, these absences are answers,
not gaps:

- **No prices**, not even ranges. Price is discussed in person.
- **No session durations, session counts, intervals or recovery times.**
- **No before/after imagery**, in any layout.
- **No efficacy percentages, statistics or study references.**
- **No testimonials, reviews or ratings** — the centre has no clients yet.
- **No staff names, credentials or qualifications.**
- **No device or product brand names, depths, concentrations or settings.**
- **No street address and no opening date.** The district is Selçuklu, Konya.
  Opening hours shown on the site are marked as provisional.

## Structure

- `/hizmetler` — 20 services in five groups: cilt bakımı, epilasyon,
  cilt yenileme, kaş & kirpik, özel paketler. Each has its own page.
- `/blog` — informational articles, six categories. No byline: the author
  field is deliberately unset.
- `/hakkimizda` — the brand, the approach, and this same list of omissions.
- `/galeri` — the site's visual language. **None of the photographs is the
  centre**; they are credited stock standing in until the real shoot.
- `/sss` — general questions, including several whose honest answer today is
  "not decided yet".
- `/iletisim` — a contact form. It emails and stores nothing.
- `/kvkk`, `/cerez-politikasi`, `/kullanim-kosullari` — legal notices,
  currently marked as unreviewed drafts.

## Machine-readable

- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Feed: /rss.xml
- Structured data: JSON-LD on every page. The business is typed `BeautySalon`
  (a `LocalBusiness`), never a medical type.
